title: Theo and the Wolf
author: Z. M. Sandoval
blurb: Ines Dunmore, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
